import json, subprocess, sys
pkts = []
for i in range(6):
    pkts.append({'id': 'a%d' % i, 'lane': i % 3, 'rank': i})
for i in range(6):
    pkts.append({'id': 'c%d' % i, 'lane': i % 3, 'rank': 10 + i})
req = {'mode': 'burst', 'banks': 4, 'lanes': 3, 'limit': 15,
       'borders': [0, 5, 10, 15], 'start_bank': 2, 'packets': pkts}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/scheduler.py'],
                   input=json.dumps(req).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('rc', p.returncode, p.stdout[:80], p.stderr[:200])
EOF
